## 5. An exact repair for this channel: sequential activation

For the declared density coupler, set each inactive module's memory-bath coupling exactly to zero. Every spectator \(M_j\) then commutes with the full Hamiltonian, and its initially empty ladder remains empty. Conditional on spectator occupations \(m_j\in\{0,1,2\}\), the active module only experiences

\[
\varepsilon_i\mapsto\varepsilon_i+\sum_{j\ne i}\lambda_{ij}m_j.
\]

There is no second emitter for the cooperative lower/upper photon pair. With one spectator and \(|\lambda|<1/2\), the shifts 0, lambda, and twice lambda keep the sufficiently weakly coupled active unit inside its local even-sector gap. In general the total shift must keep that gap open.

The cost is explicit: only one module's bath coupling is active at a time. Spectator superpositions cause conditional frequency shifts and phases, which the control protocol must account for. Imperfect switch-off, intermodule excitation exchange, and non-density interactions are outside this result. This is not a claim of protected arbitrary parallel computation.

This repair can also be useful beyond number conservation: an exactly disconnected spectator memory can still have conserved occupation. But the shifted active-unit gap must then be rechecked in the full microscopic Hamiltonian; the rotating-wave thresholds cannot simply be reused.

## F. Repairs and ordinary comparator retain their costs

Sequential activation is an exact commutator statement for the stated density
coupling. With each spectator bath coupling exactly zero,its memory occupation
commutes with the full Hamiltonian and its empty bath remains empty. Conditioning
on spectator occupations shifts the active memory frequency by the sum of the
density couplings. Its gap must remain open. Spectator superpositions retain
conditional phases. Imperfect switch-off or exchange couplers are not covered.

For bounded local deviation spectra in [-D_j,-d_j] union{0} union[d_j,D_j],
d_j>sum_(i<j)D_i makes the largest-index nonzero deviation dominate every
earlier possible cancellation. The product gap is at least the minimum of
those strict margins. B_j>6 sum_(i<j)B_i is the source's sufficient specialization;
a geometric ratio>7 pays exponential frequency span. It is not an optimum or
a rule for unbounded non-RWA parity sectors.

For the original local gate,fix P=c_+^2+c_-^2=3g^2. The governing source's
general leading functional is chi=-ab P(c_+^2-c_-^2)+O(g^6). Its calibrated
two-band case has |chi|=3abg^4; the one-accessible-band endpoints give 9abg^4.
Leading dressing bP and exchange magnitude aP match. The upper-band choice
has an exactly invariant empty lower band even under memory imbalance,because
both memories couple only to the upper rail combination. At g=0 and |epsilon|<1,
the accessible two-particle complement starts above the pair by at least
1-|epsilon|; a strict small-coupling margin retains this isolated branch.
This accepts the leading mathematical comparator and this static-detuning
subspace statement,not faster hardware or full-noise dominance. The unbalanced
coupling example in cooperative section10 has a different P and is not the
matched factor-three comparison.
